objectives.statement: Distinguish markers for uncertainty, inference, shared assumption, and reported or uncertain source.
Choose explicit opinion frames and informal approximation markers with suitable register.
Place stance markers naturally in Norwegian main clauses and avoid overloaded stacking.

notes: High-risk stance/register topic. Must contrast uncertainty, inference, shared-assumption, reported/uncertain source, explicit opinion framing, and informal approximation. Warn against stacking too many markers and against using liksom in formal writing.
